1.  Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is accordingly disposed of.
Heard the counsel for the petitioners.

2. The challenge is to the Public Notice dated 31st July 2025, issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013') in respect of the land described in the prayer clause.

3. It is the case of the petitioner that the Apex Court in the matter of Govt. of NCT of Delhi v. BSK Realtors LLP (2024) 7 SCC 370, has issued directions in paragraph 58 and that the matter was listed as a part of Serial No.5 in List D.1 in the Appendix by the Supreme Court in DDA v. Tejpal & Ors (2024) 7 SCC 433 of the said judgement.
4. The categorization is evident from the following Appendix which forms part of the judgement in DDA v. Tejpal & Ors. (supra):

Learned counsel for the petitioner claims that, deviating from the scheme as prescribed under the Act of 2013, the Apex Court has fixed a schedule in exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India, 1950 ('Constitution'), and the schedule should have been adhered to by the respondents.

7. It is claimed that the Public Notice issued under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 is sans the schedule prescribed and, as such, attracts the consequences under Section 24(2) of the Act of 2013 for not completing the acquisition proceedings within schedule.

8. It is the contention of the counsel for petitioners that the schedule, since it is in deviation from the statutory provisions, i.e. Act of 2013 and is fixed in exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution, has a mandatory effect and, as a sequel, the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 stands vitiated.
9. Accordingly, since the matter is similarly placed, issue notice.
10. Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, learned counsel appearing on behalf of R-1 & 2 as also by Mr. N. Balraj, SPC appearing for R-3/Union of India.
11. We make it clear that no further action pursuant to the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 as against the land of the petitioner be undertaken till returnable date.
